ns2:course.label: Geology of the National Parks
ns2:course.description: Develops geologic background, concepts, and principles through study of selected national parks and monuments. Examines the geologic framework and history, modern geologic processes, and factors influencing the present day landscape for each park area. Same as ESE 104.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture section.
